problems.reason: The age ranges for Gracilisuchus are inconsistent: 25 cites Anisian–Ladinian (240–235 Ma), 26 limits it to Ladinian (241.464–237 Ma), and 27 gives an early Carnian age (236–234 Ma).

notes: - contradiction: "It lived in the middle Triassic, during the Anisian and Ladinian stages, approximately 240 to 235 million years ago." / "Its time range is estimated from 241.464 to 237 million years ago during the Ladinian." / "Uranium-lead dating of Chañares deposits in 2016 indicated an early Carnian age of 236 to 234 million years.": The age ranges for Gracilisuchus are inconsistent: 25 cites Anisian–Ladinian (240–235 Ma), 26 limits it to Ladinian (241.464–237 Ma), and 27 gives an early Carnian age (236–234 Ma).
